    Full idempotents: Morita equivalence for representation-finiteness #

    For Lemma 4.7 (lem:homogeneous-projection): "Repeated labels give matrix multiplicities, and the distinct labels give an idempotent corner of B. Thus B' is representation-finite by Morita equivalence and Lemma 3.1(1)."

    The Morita equivalence used is the one of a full idempotent e (AeA = A): every right A-module N is the coinduced module Hom_C(Ae, Ne) of its C = eAe-module Ne (theta_bijective). Hence if eAe is representation-finite, so is A (isRepresentationFinite_of_full). Repeated labels are handled by placing them, together with the distinct labels, in one category algebra in which the distinct labels form a full idempotent (CategoryAlgebraCorners.lean).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
